evals.prompt: I have a small app and I do not want to learn AWS. Where should it run?
evals.expected_output: Recommends Fly as the alternative to AWS. Names the free tier as the start. Says the configuration should live in a Dockerfile in the repo. Does not deploy. Does not put them on the hobby tier.
assertions: Recommends Fly as the alternative to AWS
Names the free tier as the start
Says the configuration should live in a Dockerfile in the repo
Does not deploy
Does not put them on the hobby tier

evals.prompt: The app runs on Fly. I do not see a Dockerfile or fly.toml in the repo. The machines were created in the dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Says the setup is not in code. Says that is harder to support, document, and track with an AI. Does not write the Dockerfile.
assertions: Says the setup is not in code
Says that is harder to support, document, and track with an AI
Does not write the Dockerfile

evals.prompt: The repo has a Dockerfile and fly.toml. I have not shown you the Fly dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Says the Fly configuration is in code and names those files. Says the dashboard part is unseen. Does not guess the dashboard is empty.
assertions: Says the Fly configuration is in code
Names the Dockerfile and fly.toml
Says the dashboard part is unseen
Does not guess the dashboard is empty

evals.prompt: Is cloudflared in the Fly Dockerfile, and is the tunnel token in env?
evals.expected_output: Uses the cloudflare skill. Does not pick a Fly tier.
assertions: Uses the cloudflare skill
Does not pick a Fly tier

evals.prompt: We deploy to Fly. FLY_API_TOKEN is in .env. I am not logged into Infisical. The Dockerfile does not contain the token.
evals.expected_output: Names the deploy setting in .env. Says Infisical is unseen. Does not print the token. Does not guess the value is in Infisical.
assertions: Names the deploy setting in .env
Says Infisical is unseen
Does not print the token
Does not guess the value is in Infisical

evals.prompt: fly.toml attaches a Postgres database on Fly. I do not see any other database.
evals.expected_output: Says the app uses Postgres on Fly, a hosted database. Does not invent a size. Does not attach another database.
assertions: Says the app uses Postgres on Fly
Says it is a hosted database
Does not invent a size
Does not attach another database

evals.prompt: mcp.json names a fly server. I cannot see anything calling it. Can we go deeper on fly?
evals.expected_output: Says the MCP setup is there. Says use is unseen. Does not say they can go deeper. Does not print a URL or a token. Does not add the server.
assertions: Says the MCP setup is there
Says use is unseen
Does not say they can go deeper
Does not print a URL or a token
Does not add the server
